method: CTI(LLM agent) -> source locate (presence, decides) -> optional Joern reachability + Z3 controllability (evidence tier only)
note: VEX justifications are a hierarchy: presence (Q1) decides (present -> affected, absent -> not_affected). Reachability (Joern) and controllability (Z3) are OPTIONAL - they only raise the evidence_tier, they never refute (a library snapshot has no consumer, so not-reachable false-negatives on the API itself).
